notes.title: 🎉 We're Live! 🚀
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

We're thrilled to announce that Dungeon Renovation Simulator is now officially launched and ready for you to enjoy! After overcoming technical hurdles and countless hours of hard work, we're excited to finally share our creation with you.

Immerse yourself in the captivating world we've crafted, embark on thrilling adventures, and experience the excitement of our game firsthand. We can't wait to hear your feedback and see you dive into the gameplay.

Thank you for your patience and support throughout this journey. Your enthusiasm has fueled our determination to deliver the best gaming experience possible.

Let the adventure begin!

notes.title: Join Our Live Gameplay of Dungeon Renovation Simulator
notes.notes:
Join us as we broadcast live gameplay of Dungeon Renovation Simulator directly on Steam! Tune in to witness the excitement as we delve deep into the dungeons, tackling cobwebs, dust, and all manner of mystical messes. Whether you're a seasoned cleaner or a curious adventurer, there's something for everyone in this unique gaming experience.

Don't miss out on this opportunity to join the cleaning revolution and experience Dungeon Renovation Simulator like never before. Gather your cleaning supplies and get ready for a dungeon-cleaning extravaganza!

Let's clean up the dungeons together!

notes.title: Update: Delay in Game Release
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

We regret to inform you that the release of Dungeon Renovation Simulator, which was scheduled for today, has been delayed due to unforeseen technical issues. We understand how eager you all are to dive into the world we've created, and we sincerely apologize for any disappointment this may cause.

Please rest assured that our team is working tirelessly to resolve these issues as quickly as possible. We are committed to delivering a polished and enjoyable gaming experience, and we appreciate your patience and understanding during this time.

We will keep you updated on our progress, and we assure you that we will launch the game as soon as the technical issues are resolved. Thank you for your continued support and enthusiasm for our game.

Best regards,
Giant Cat Games

notes.title: Launch Day is Near!
notes.notes:
Ground Control to Major Goblin, it's time to prepare for the launch.

After long and hardworking months of dedication and passion, we're thrilled to announce that the wait is almost over! [b]Dungeon Renovation Simulator[/b] is finally ready to launch in just 7 days!

Save the date: [b]April 2[/b] marks the culmination of our journey together.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43298763/787902e77e45d3ef5decc445f9f2246248ae14a7.jpg[/img]

We poured our hearts and souls into crafting an experience we hope you'll love. Get ready to immerse yourself in a world filled with adventure, challenge, and wonder! Stay tuned for more updates and an amazing [b]launch trailer[/b] as we count down the days!

Thank you for your support and excitement. We couldn't have done it without you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43298763/85e0f432ef41f898b3c471d0b709cd84d920c1c6.png[/img]

notes.title: DevLog #6 New Year, New Advancements!
notes.notes:
Hello Dungeoneers! Long time no see! We've been very busy after the release of our prologue, fixing the game for you! Thanks to everyone who helped us with catching the bugs. We're aware there are still some that occur sometimes. Please let us know if you see one! 

This week, we're continuing with the updates on how our game is going! Well, there's not much we can show other than bug fixes, but we did add one thing to the game. Look at what happens when you burn the cobwebs with a torch!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43298763/cc452a325a66abc23ca658c7ddc1827445eca1c2.gif[/img]


Also, we've been playing around with the slimes, and look at that: we invented unicorn slime ^^ We're probably not going to use it, but what do you think? ^^

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43298763/c3ab93b3723e195bc0f9693f85c92cf7a52df6f3.gif[/img]


Anyway, that's a wrap for this week! Hope to see you again next week!

notes.title: Devlog #5 Achievements Unlocked!
notes.notes:
Hello there, dungeoneers! With less than a week left until the release of our prologue, we hereby want to update you on our Devlog and kindly remind you to wishlist our prologue if you haven't already!

Let's start by talking about the abilities of the Arcane Sucker. We already introduced you to the Arcane Sucker and showed off some abilities. Of course, there is more to it. The Arcane Sucker sucks up everything. This includes spider webs, too. Check out what we did with it last week! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43298763/16f3d6bf2068cabce092a8237912d9a0c95a6899.gif[/img]

[b]Mushrooms[/b]
Next, we want to show you a surprise feature in our game. Normally, in cleaning games, eating is an unexpected mechanic, and it sounds kind of gross tbh. But would you look at these mushrooms? How can you resist eating them?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43298763/b85c146ead2e22239981a9923603e935568c5df4.gif[/img]

[b]Achievements[/b]
Lastly, we've added achievements to the prologue! Wait until 22nd December to find out if you can have them all!   

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43298763/a1e7532503ce99a1492a58a3a71c26bc6d87d470.png[/img]

[b]Ask the Devs![/b]
Here in this part, we answer your questions ^^

[b]How can we report the bugs we encounter?[/b]
You can report the bugs in the main menu or the in-game menu. Click on the bug icon to report!
Or, you can join our discord server and directly connect and chat with the devs ^^

[b]How many levels will you release in the prologue?[/b]
We will release one additional level, so you will have two levels to play ^^

We say goodbye for now with an art piece you can find in the prologue. There is something.. special about it. I guess you'll find out what when you play it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43298763/9b40b1db15b1db9e114a52585fc173c142fe3818.png[/img]

notes.title: Devlog #4 - HUGE News!!
notes.notes:
Hello there, fellow dungeoneers! A new week means a new devlog! This week's devlog will not be very long, but it will be exciting! We have very exciting news. Our prologue is coming on 22nd December! Do you know what this means? You get to play one more level for free ^^ So let's discuss what we'll have in the prologue.

[b]The Castle:[/b] You've all played the demo (we hope!), and you already know this level. In the prologue, you can replay it, this time with fewer bugs ofc ^^

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779256/21a8108a7834550d77a2e4182e7520c4179ca1ee.png[/img]

[b]Prison:[/b] The second level is a prison level! We don't want to spoil it much, but here's a sneak peek of your upcoming challenges. 

[b]New dirt type![/b] You will discover new dirt types and ways to clean them in the prologue ^^

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779256/ff9672aeb80fbc1c98169e397ea2661254bb182f.png[/img]

You'll also see that we have an updated and better UI, all made to make the dungeon-cleaning experience better for you. We're so excited! So go ahead and wishlist the prologue if you haven't already!!!!!

Here is the link ^^ See you next week!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2707460/Dungeon_Renovation_Simulator_Prologue/?medium=steam

notes.title: Devlog #3 - Blackholes and Fairies!
notes.notes:
Hello once again, Dungeoneers! This week, we will cover the "black hole" in our game and how cool it is. Also, big news! We are developing our game step by step every day, and we are proud to show you what we have been working on for the past couple of weeks ^^ Scroll down to find out more.  


So, the "black hole" in our game is the trash portal. It sucks in everything you throw at it, even the bigger things like chairs and barrels. Even we don't know where the things you put in it go, but the further it goes, the better, so we hope it's someplace far from our dungeons. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43298763/f2533036e43cd92062ac99f1fbe5710941ff4e80.gif[/img]


With this portal, you can move it and carry it around with you. We told you it was cool!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43298763/d56166ab589e58f014b654bdb2c85f60b2703404.gif[/img]


Exciting news! Sneak peek on the new level! So, of course, we've been working on new levels since the demo's release... And this one we're showing here is very colorful and exciting. We thought it was so much fun to clean! It may even be our favorite level so far. Any guesses about who made this mess?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43298763/5158f0091de8a350c16f64462edb7f6e1a068185.png[/img]

You've guessed it! It's a fairy... We are also working on new characters, so there will be more creatures to make a mess for you to clean. Pick up your arcane sucker already!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43298763/2a52827c258518db65fd0976e611bc8d1d3fc78e.gif[/img]

[b]Bug of the Week[/b]
We rated the bugs you sent our way and picked our favorite. Here's the bug of the week. Keep sending us videos of bugs you catch to get featured next week!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43298763/72ae15ee7abfa13904e350ca1df7c4647e5ad1b8.gif[/img]
Did it just move by itself?

[b]Ask the Devs![/b]
Here in this part, we answer your questions ^^

[b]Will there be a prologue?[/b]
We are working on it! Keep following us to find out more.

[b]Will there be other dirt types than the ones in the demo?[/b]
Yes! With each new level, you will have new dirt types to clean!

notes.title: Devlog #2 Flasks & Blobs and Cages
notes.notes:
Greetings, Dungeoneers! Phew, what a week it's been! Nice to see you all again! So last week, we asked our community on our [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/DungeonRenovationSim/]Reddit[/url] and [url=https://discord.gg/VR7hQAZK]Discord[/url] to pick a model for us to use in the game. We love interacting with our community and asking their opinion! So, we want to share the poll here once again. Which model should we use as an artifact? It will be altered to look like a goblin ^^ Comment your preferences!

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43298763/2c8e9678fef0d9d70bf9bbcbc13c776cd5a92402.jpg[/img]

Next, we have some additions to our game. This week, we want to tell you about what we did and HOW we did it! 

[b]1)[/b] The first one is that we created this flask for our game. You can pick this flask and throw it around- just like every other asset in our game!- but slightly different. We created a blob object to spawn when you break the flask. It has a material that moves the blob's vertices using[b] material masking and vertex world position offset[/b] when the blob is moving.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43298763/84fecd4216296268edb457bd33673b9c4a3bacb4.gif[/img]

[b]2)[/b] Cages! If you try hard enough, these cages will fall and break. They are equipped with a chain object, managed using the [b]cable component[/b]. We update the chain’s transform via the cable component’s provided particle location list. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43298763/5ecfdf5b0d6a2028cecc2500838b9289619c8ec5.gif[/img]

[b]Bug of the week - Developer's Choice[/b]
We rated the bugs you sent our way and picked our favorite. Here's the bug of the week. Keep sending us videos of bugs you catch to get featured next week!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43298763/3e422ebb7807ebf35fb6a08df5c84edba5cb507d.gif[/img]
[b]Ask the Devs![/b]
Here in this part, we answer your questions ^^

[b]Is Steam Workshop support planned?[/b]
Not that we planned of... What do you think about it?

[b]Do you plan to add more characters?[/b]
There will be NPCs in the full release.

[b]When will the game be released?[/b] 
We are planning to release the game in early access in April 2024.

notes.title: Devlog #1 Let's talk about cleaning...
notes.notes:
It's a new week and it's time for a new DevLog! Greetings once again, fellow dungeoneers, and a warm welcome to those who recently joined us ^^
In this week's DevLog, we will discuss this huge issue in our lives and the solutions Goblin has found: Cleaning. As the elders said, "Cleanliness is next to Gobliness" and our Goblin sure has found his own unique ways of cleaning. So now, I introduce you to the "Arcane Sucker."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43298763/dd131508b1689b1c539df0ae90283baa7c406d2f.png[/img]
This tool is the best friend of a Goblin who's devoted his life and all being to cleaning dungeons. This tool vacuums and mops; the best part is its infinite storage. So say goodbye to those pesky slimes forever with this fantastic tool! With its special mop, you can be sure there won't be a claw-print left from those naughty dragons.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43298763/1603e84df25aecfb86c0b8850a8651d2a8f4dad8.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43298763/20e701676f525713563396c27974c23c65a36857.gif[/img]

Our following tool is -and every cleaning freak needs this tool in his life so bad- the "Detection Glass." The detection glass is the ultimate tool to use when cleaning a dungeon. It highlights the stains, trash, and slimes, making cleaning an even bigger joy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43298763/f2b2483a982b91e12f786a891f1da38a77223b01.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43298763/ecfe2fe5cfeed953a3e8a8663da43b3be1256670.png[/img]

[b]Ask the Devs![/b]
Here in this part, we answer your questions ^^

[i][b]Will there be VR support?[/b][/i]
 Not yet ^^

[i][b]Which game engine did you use for this game?[/b][/i]
We used Unreal Engine 5 for the development of our game.

[i][b]Will there be multiplayer?[/b][/i]
Yes! In the full release, you will be able to play the game with your friends ^^

[i][b]Will there be community meetings?[/b][/i]
Yess, we have a community on Discord and Reddit. We are planning to do our community meetups and playtests there. Make sure to join them  🙂 

[url=https://discord.gg/zVtYSczj]Join our Discord[/url]
[url=https://www.reddit.com/r/DungeonRenovationSim/]Join our Reddit![/url]

[i][b]How many levels will there be?[/b][/i]
For the first release, we are planning to release 5 unique levels. As you move through the levels, you will find many unique souvenirs and artifacts ^^

Follow us for the upcoming details! Have a slime-free and happy week everyone ^^

notes.title: DevLog #0 Welcome!
notes.notes:
Hello there, fellow dungeoneers! Thanks for the interest in the first indie game we're developing as a team of 5 🙂

We now have a demo, hooray!! We are excited to keep you updated on the development process and give you insight into our progress for almost a year. So, let the DevLogs begin!

We started off developing the Dungeon Renovation Simulator to combine the two unique experiences and create an even more distinguished experience: the unexpected joy of cleaning and the enchantment of medieval fantasy. What essentially started as a cleaning simulator became so much more, creating a world full of immersion, exploration, and storytelling. We invite you to play the demo and explore our dungeons!

[b]The Goblin[/b]
Hope you've met the Goblin already! His home is the dungeons. Do you trust yourself to fill his shoes? If you think yes, go to our demo and give it a try! See if you succeed at scavaging the dungeons and cleaning them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43298763/2d6b94a2940274783f5e918ebea322f910c5acbd.jpg[/img]


[b]The Temple[/b]
The temple is where we meet, where everyone meets. This big ol' tree, you see? Meet us under it! That is, of course, if you can pass the carefully designed levels of the dungeon...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43298763/6eb66fe9a8fd5823a6598ef5bf959a72e5d21731.jpg[/img]


So this is it for now! Join our community on Discord for exclusive sneak peeks and chats!

You can also find us on reddit, [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/DungeonRenovationSim/]r/DungeonRenovationSim[/url] and join the discussion!

[url=https://discord.gg/u8V4PUEn]JOIN OUR DISCORD! [/url]

notes.title: Dungeon Renovation Simulator - Demo Live Stream
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43298763/4230100e02966086123dc609e68925c466116761.png[/img]
Immerse yourself in the role of a "Goblin" and renovate dungeons in first-person view. Clean up various types of dirts, do mysterious physics based quests, order new items and transform dungeons into your medieval playground in this chillax simulation game.

Come and join our community in this journey! We are exited to see your works.
